report_name: Reference vs Optimized Identity Graph Discrepancy Audit

differing_edges.reference_reason: Brute-force O(N^2) evaluation reached exact boundary score 0.70 via synthetic 1.0 appearance match despite vehicle-type mismatch
differing_edges.candidate_gate_reason: Vehicle type mismatch (car vs truck) without verified compatible reid_model attribute
differing_edges.expected_semantics: Type-mismatched observations lacking verified common ReID model space or verified OCR plate match must NOT form unconditional identity edges at 0.70
differing_edges.semantic_divergence_root_cause: In brute-force reference path, match_observations computed feasibility = 0.70 * 1.0 + 0.30 * 0.0 = 0.70. Combined with synthetic appearance similarity 1.00, estimated_prob landed exactly on the threshold 0.70, adding an ambiguous edge to ref_graph. Conversely, the optimized CandidateGenerator safely pruned this car-truck pair because reid_model was unverified/missing. Furthermore, in production, an ambiguous score (0.70) with an unverified vehicle type mismatch should not form an edge without explicit override evidence.
